sub_graphs.title: EIP-155: Chain-Specific Transaction Signing
sub_graphs.description: Models the transaction signing process with chain ID inclusion for replay protection

nodes.label: Transaction Created
nodes.description: Raw transaction data prepared with nonce, gasprice, startgas, to, value, data

nodes.label: Prepare Signing Data
nodes.description: RLP encode nine elements: (nonce, gasprice, startgas, to, value, data, chainid, 0, 0)

nodes.label: Nine-Element Hash Ready
nodes.description: Transaction hash computed from nine RLP elements including CHAIN_ID

nodes.label: Sign with Private Key
nodes.description: ECDSA sign the hash to produce r, s, and recovery parameter

nodes.label: Compute v Parameter
nodes.description: Calculate v = {0,1} + CHAIN_ID * 2 + 35 where {0,1} is y-value parity

nodes.label: Transaction Signed
nodes.description: Transaction signed with chain-specific v value (v, r, s)

external_entities.name: Wallet/Signer
external_entities.description: External wallet or signing mechanism that creates and signs transactions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-155: Transaction Signature Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation of EIP-155 signatures including chain ID verification

nodes.label: Signed Transaction Received
nodes.description: Node receives a signed transaction for validation

nodes.label: Extract v Parameter
nodes.description: Extract v value from transaction signature

nodes.label: Check v Format
nodes.description: Determine if v indicates legacy (27/28) or EIP-155 format

nodes.label: Legacy Format Detected
nodes.description: v is 27 or 28, use six-element hash for recovery

nodes.label: EIP-155 Format Detected
nodes.description: v > 28, extract chain ID and use nine-element hash

nodes.label: Extract Chain ID from v
nodes.description: Calculate CHAIN_ID = (v - 35) / 2

nodes.label: Verify Chain ID Matches Network
nodes.description: Check extracted chain ID matches current network's CHAIN_ID

nodes.label: Chain ID Mismatch
nodes.description: Transaction chain ID does not match network - reject

nodes.label: Recover Public Key
nodes.description: ECDSA recover signer public key using appropriate hash

nodes.label: Signature Valid
nodes.description: Signature verified and sender address recovered

external_entities.name: Transaction Broadcaster
external_entities.description: External entity submitting signed transactions to the network

sub_graphs.title: EIP-155: Cross-Chain Replay Protection
sub_graphs.description: Models how EIP-155 prevents transaction replay across different chains

nodes.label: Transaction on Chain A
nodes.description: Valid transaction signed for chain A (e.g., mainnet CHAIN_ID=1)

nodes.label: Attempt Replay on Chain B
nodes.description: Attacker broadcasts same transaction to chain B (different CHAIN_ID)

nodes.label: Validate on Chain B
nodes.description: Chain B validates transaction signature

nodes.label: Chain ID Invalid for Network
nodes.description: Extracted chain ID does not match chain B's CHAIN_ID

nodes.label: Replay Attack Rejected
nodes.description: Transaction rejected due to chain ID mismatch

nodes.label: Legacy TX Could Be Replayed
nodes.description: Pre-EIP-155 transaction (v=27/28) may be valid on multiple chains

edges.label: Attacker captures transaction from chain A

external_entities.name: Replay Attacker
external_entities.description: Malicious actor attempting to replay transactions across chains

ambiguities.text: The specification uses 'SHOULD' rather than 'MUST' for the nine-element hashing, leaving room for non-compliance.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Treat 'SHOULD' as mandatory for security purposes; non-compliant implementations are vulnerable to replay attacks.

ambiguities.text: The handling of transactions with v values that don't fit the expected patterns (27, 28, or CHAIN_ID*2+35/36) is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume transactions with invalid v values are rejected as malformed.

ambiguities.text: No specification for how to handle CHAIN_ID=0 which would produce v values of 35/36.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume CHAIN_ID=0 is invalid and should not be used.

implicit_assumptions.description: Each Ethereum-compatible chain uses a unique CHAIN_ID value.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Two chains with the same CHAIN_ID would allow replay attacks between them.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallets and signing tools will correctly implement the chain ID inclusion in signatures.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may unknowingly create replay-vulnerable transactions.

implicit_assumptions.description: Legacy transactions (v=27/28) are still accepted for backward compatibility.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Old unsigned transactions would become invalid, breaking historical compatibility.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers can observe and rebroadcast transactions on any public chain.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If transaction visibility is limited, replay attacks become less practical (but EIP-155 still provides defense in depth).
